name: Moganshan Shibamai Mountain Spring Villa
aiSummary: Review summary Powered by AI Environment:Nestled in a mountainous area with serene, picturesque settings, offering mountain views, starry skies from terraces, and natural elements like grassy lawns for barbecues.(based on 1 review) Amenities:Features a swimming pool, hot spring, sunroom, ping-pong table, chess room, and swings. Rooms are spacious, designed in European or American rustic styles, and highly photogenic.(based on 4 reviews) Service:Hosts and staff are described as warm, attentive, and helpful, offering personalized recommendations for local activities, travel planning, and accommodations.(based on 6 reviews) Design & Facilities:Emphasized thoughtful interior details and access to wellness activities like hot spring bathing and stargazing.(based on 3 reviews) Hygiene:Most reviews noted clean rooms, odor-free environments, and proper sanitation for shared facilities.(based on 3 reviews)

topics.text: Nestled in a mountainous area with serene, picturesque settings, offering mountain views, starry skies from terraces, and natural elements like grassy lawns for barbecues.
Features a swimming pool, hot spring, sunroom, ping-pong table, chess room, and swings. Rooms are spacious, designed in European or American rustic styles, and highly photogenic.
Hosts and staff are described as warm, attentive, and helpful, offering personalized recommendations for local activities, travel planning, and accommodations.
Emphasized thoughtful interior details and access to wellness activities like hot spring bathing and stargazing.
Most reviews noted clean rooms, odor-free environments, and proper sanitation for shared facilities.

address: Village Group 8, Miaoqian Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, 313206, China

comments.quote: 藏在山林中的一座歐式小築，環境雅緻寧靜，內裝別具一格。民宿中有游泳池、温泉、棋牌室、乒乓台、陽光房、大小秋千，還可以在草坪上燒烤。 老闆人很好，熱情，服務周到。
comments.author: Wennuantuo
comments.quoteEn: A small European style house hidden in the woods, quiet and elegant, with unusual decoration inside. There is a pool, a hot spring, a card room, a table tennis table, a sun room and swings of two sizes, and you can barbecue on the lawn. The owner is a good sort, welcoming and attentive.

comments.quote: 設施：環境不錯 可見山景 露台抬頭看星星很美 最大問題是走廊與房間隔音很差 每次有人路過或者開房門開鎖聲音都很嚇人 衞生：正常 服務：店主會推薦旅行
comments.author: Anonymous User
